tech_stack.description: Runtime technology preferences for the ADLC pipeline. Standalone agents only — orchestration owned by GenWiz. Read by config_loader.py at startup. Not read by any LLM agent.

runtime._orchestration_note: GenWiz owns all orchestration. ADLC exposes standalone stateless agents only.

config_loader._note: Add new agent config files here as they are created. PL-00 removed — GenWiz owns orchestration.

logging._security_note: Never log raw_prompt or business_case contents in prod — may contain sensitive data

shared_folder._note: All agents read input files from {base_path}/{thread_id}/{input_subfolder}/ and write output to {base_path}/{thread_id}/{output_subfolder}/. Supports json, docx, pdf, html.

GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.description: GCP project ID hosting the Vertex AI Gemini endpoint

GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION.description: GCP region for the Vertex AI endpoint (e.g. us-central1)

GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.description: Absolute path to the service-account JSON used to authenticate to Vertex

GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI.description: Set to 'true' to route google-genai calls through Vertex (already forced by code via vertexai=True)

GIT_TOKEN.description: Git PAT for ADLC audit repo commits

ADLC_AUDIT_REPO_URL.description: Git repo URL for audit trail commits

testing._note: Set run_real_llm_tests: true locally to run integration tests against real Vertex Gemini API

metadata._changes: v2.0.0 — removed LangGraph, checkpointer, state, orchestration. GenWiz owns orchestration. ADLC is standalone agent service.

git_writer._note: Does not block agent HTTP response

git_reader._note: When an agent has git_reader.enabled: false, files are read from {local_audit_dir}/{git_path} on local disk. When enabled: true, GitPython clones/fetches the audit repo into {cache_dir} and reads from there.

llm_defaults._note: System-wide LLM defaults inherited by all agents. Agent llm_config_override only needs to set max_tokens and timeout_seconds.

folder_structure._gitops_note: Package named 'gitops' (not 'git') to avoid shadowing the GitPython 'git' package on sys.path.
